comment: Licenses concluded for components whose own metadata does not state a usable license. Each package identifies a component by a purl without version; versionInfo is the version its license was checked for (or a range such as [4.0,5) where the license cannot change with the version), and the build fails when another version ships. Check an entry again when the component is upgraded; the generator fails on entries that no component uses.

packages.name: xz
packages.licenseComments: The POM of version 1.9 declares "Public Domain", which has no SPDX identifier. Versions from 1.10 on are 0BSD.

packages.name: derive4j-annotation
packages.licenseComments: The POM names "The GNU Lesser General Public License" without a version and links to https://github.com/derive4j/derive4j/blob/master/annotation/LICENSE.txt, which is the LGPL v3 text without an "or later" grant.
